verdict.rationale: Access review applies to an identity and admin platform like Google Workspace, but the evidence pack never documents certification campaigns, reviewer routing, scheduled re-justification, or sign-off records. The audit/usage Reports API, user listing, and Apps Script automation are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a security engineer, access gets re-justified on a schedule — certification campaigns route who-has-what to reviewers and produce audit-ready sign-off records
